summary: Completed frontend testing of RACCOON APP UI redesign. Fixed critical bug: loginAsGuest function was missing from AuthContext, preventing guest users from starting matches. All tested features working correctly after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: loginAsGuest function was missing from AuthContext.js - added implementation that calls /api/auth/guest endpoint

test_credentials.guest_user: No credentials needed - click Start Matching on /guest page

context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest login flow now working. Match page searching state verified on both desktop and mobile. Game components (TruthOrDare, RaccoonFeud) have proper animations in code but cannot be tested without actual match (requires 2 users). WebRTC video call is MOCKED (requires 2 users).

landing_page.details: Clean UI, no external branding visible, Start button works, footer links present (Terms, Privacy, Guidelines, 18+ only)

guest_page_mobile.details: All buttons visible on mobile (390x844), gender selection works, lock icons on premium features (Male/Female in 'Match me with', Country filter)

guest_page_premium_gating.details: Premium modal appears when clicking locked features, View Plans and Maybe Later buttons work

match_page_navigation.details: Fixed loginAsGuest function in AuthContext.js - guest users can now start matching

match_page_searching_state_desktop.details: Finding a Match text visible, raccoon image and facts rotating, back button and filter button visible

match_page_searching_state_mobile.details: All elements visible on mobile viewport (390x844), back button, filter button, raccoon emojis bouncing

match_page_matched_state_code_review.details: All required UI elements present in code: Skip/Report/Block buttons with data-testid, video controls, game buttons (Truth/Dare, Feud) with lock icons, chat input, camera filter selector

truth_or_dare_animation.details: Spin animation implemented with spinRotation state and CSS transform, 1200ms delay before reveal

raccoon_feud_animation.details: Reveal animation implemented with revealingIndex state, scale transform, and 600ms delay

branding_removal.details: No 'Made with Emergent' branding visible - hidden via CSS in App.css and JavaScript in App.js

bug_fixed.root_cause: Guest.js was calling loginAsGuest from useAuth() but the function was not defined in AuthContext.js
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added loginAsGuest async function to AuthContext.js that calls /api/auth/guest endpoint and stores token/user

mocked_apis_confirmed: WebRTC peer connection (requires 2 users to test)
Firebase Auth (Google, Apple, Phone) - shows 'coming soon' toast
notes: Match page matched state UI cannot be fully tested without 2 concurrent users
Game animations (spin, reveal) verified through code review - actual animation testing requires matched state
Camera auto-start is configured in useWebRTC hook with autoStart=true parameter
